card.title: How to fix an iPad that will charge when powered off but not when powered on

source.title: How to fix an iPad that will charge when powered off but not when powered on

claims.statement: These iPads can draw about 2.3 A on the charger while off, then drop to 0 A once booted; replugging also shows 0 A.
This is almost always a faulty PMIC, and replacing it fixes most cases.

procedure: Confirm the charge draw pattern on a USB meter (off vs booted).
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
